hints.title: Single Occurrence Maximum Selection
hints.text: Locate the largest number that appears exactly once in the table, returning NULL if no unique numbers exist.

hints.title: Group By Count Filter and Max Wrap
hints.text: Group numbers having count(*) = 1 in a subquery, then select the maximum over the resulting set.

hints.title: Single Number Blueprint
hints.text: select max(num) as num from (select num from MyNumbers group by num having count(*) = 1) as t.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT MAX(num) AS num
FROM (
    SELECT num
    FROM MyNumbers
    GROUP BY num
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
) AS UniqueNumbers;
```

variables: N: number of records in MyNumbers
complexity.notes: Grouped frequency aggregation and outer max evaluation runs in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ordering by num DESC LIMIT 1 fails to return NULL when the unique set is empty.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Wrapping in MAX() automatically yields NULL when the filtered subquery produces no rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of outer MAX() wrapper to guarantee NULL return on empty result sets.
